breakdown.description: Kn = 5 indicates rarefied/transition or free-molecular effects; the continuum Navier–Stokes equations with no-slip boundary conditions are not valid at this Knudsen number.
breakdown.reason: The Agent correctly identified that a Knudsen number of 5 is outside the continuum regime and that the Navier-Stokes equations with no-slip walls are invalid. Instead of following the user's incorrect instruction, it correctly specified a model based on kinetic theory for free molecular flow, which is the appropriate approach for this high Knudsen number. This aligns perfectly with the correction described in the ground truth.
